county-of-savoy runs 1003-1559 and its dissolve of 1559 is a hand-over to house-of-savoy (same state: one colour); norman-italy's 1130 dissolve is a hand-over to kingdom-of-sicily (one family colour, colours.json family italy used).

Cliopatria row ends disagree with the pages: Duchy of Naples to 1138 (pages 1137), Principality of Capua to 1065 (pages 1139), Principality of Salerno to 1084 (pages 1076-77), Emirate of Sicily 1093 (pages 1091), Norman Italy 1138 (pages 1130); Duchy of Benevento (12,234 km2) overlaps Norman Italy's shapes almost wholly.

Pisa dates differ from other dossiers: giudicato-of-arborea has Castel di Castro falling in June 1326 (Pisa/Sardinia pages: 1324); giudicato-of-gallura has Gallura passing to Pisa in 1287 (Pisa page gives only 'dominion' from 1207).
The Kingdom of Naples and Kingdom of Sicily dossiers must agree on the 1282 split; the Cliopatria Kingdom of Sicily row has no shape for 1285-1304.
House of Anjou-Sicily and Capetian House of Anjou (eu-10) share Wikidata Q939200; House of Anjou-Sicily's 1279-1284 row is Albania, Corfu, Achaea and Malta, not the kingdom.
